tldr: North Node in House 9: growth through faith, higher learning, publishing, law, travel, and lived philosophy.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop faith, higher learning, publishing, law, travel, and lived philosophy. The South Node in House 3 shows the familiar life field: facts without meaning, local noise, sibling scripts, or endless mental motion. The house axis describes where the growth has to become lived, not just understood. The practice is to commit to a worldview that can guide action.
business: Growth becomes practical when the person chooses faith, higher learning, publishing, law, travel, and lived philosophy in the concrete house topics of daily life.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in House 3 can pull the person back toward facts without meaning, local noise, sibling scripts, or endless mental motion.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node house names the growth field; South Node house names the familiar field. Requires accurate birth time for house placement.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
